records.body:
Closed as absorbed into #512. The Observatory experience-design contract is now embodied by the #512 executable implementation, markup, interaction states, accessibility contracts, and focused review surface; a separate #511 implementation path or PR would duplicate that work.

The inherited OBS-A requirements remain explicit in #512: stable information contracts for every final view; designed and proven empty, degraded, recovery, and revoked states; keyboard and screen-reader flows; and source-grounded Runtime fields with no invented authority. The consolidated review handoff is retained in the #512 worktree at `.csdlc/evidence/512/CLAUDE_REVIEW_HANDOFF.md`, and Claude is currently remediating its findings.

This no-PR closure records scope absorption only. It does not claim #512 is complete, reviewed, merged, or ready to close. #512 remains the active delivery issue and must pass its focused identity, roster-ordering, accessibility, recovery, documentation, exact-browser, and fresh exact-head review gates before completion.

<!-- csdlc-github-operation:issue-511-absorption-closeout-comment-v1 -->

Produce one implemented Observatory redesign backed by authentic Runtime projections.

## Primary deliverable

One implemented Observatory redesign consuming authentic Runtime projections.

## Verification result

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one implemented Observatory redesign; browser and authority cases are proof inputs.

## Dependencies

- OBS-A: #511
- Sprint 8 coordination: #536

Issue #84 is independent backlog work and is not a dependency or execution gate for #512.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] OBS-A contracts are implemented
- [ ] Runtime projections are source-grounded
- [ ] Accessibility and recovery cases pass
- [ ] No mock substitutes for the required Runtime route

- `exact-browser-cases`
- `accessibility`

- A mock substitutes for the required Runtime route
